author: integrated_case_peer
genre: Research design, not a new technical graduate-theory chapter. Two complete substantive design contracts and eight solved original exercises; all elementary arithmetic and finite expectation/identification arguments proved directly.

coverage_review.estimand: Separates target, estimator and realization; exact equal-bank offer ITT and exposed-bank ATT, units/horizons/populations/weights, treatment versus uptake and borrower versus bank targets.
coverage_review.mechanism: Maps funding/resources/lending plus demand/risk/selection; explicit direct-offer versus uptake observational equivalence; total effect does not identify mediation.
coverage_review.identification: Full finite-design expectation argument and six assignment enumeration; D=tau+b derivation with no-anticipation/unaffected-control restrictions; exact two worlds and constructive sharp sensitivity interval.
coverage_review.counterfactual: Defines missing potential outcomes; two observed histories with differing untreated post endpoints; effect positive despite observed decline; pretrend and sample-size limits.
coverage_review.feasibility: Assignment/authority/access/ethics, measurement reconciliation, fixed roster/exit mapping, spillover information, result-independent stop/pivot and ownership roles.
coverage_review.alternative_explanations: Demand, funding selection, direct signal, interference, selective reporting, stock/flow confusion and borrower substitution, each with targeted evidence and claim consequences.

full_reading.cases: Read both complete contracts, all tables, exact proof paragraphs, threat/consequence and decision memos. ContractA does not treat the teaching full schedule as observable empirical data or claim sufficient power; contractB preserves the untestable counterfactual restriction and distinct sampling uncertainty.
full_reading.exercises: Read each of eight original prompts and its full solution; both determinate calculations and open-ended criteria are complete. e8 has a supplied constraint and a concrete conditional first-paper decision, not a blank template.
full_reading.teachback_retention: Both have answer guides with explicit examples and evidence/claim boundaries.
full_reading.sources: Read acceptedC01/C02 material and the exact retainedV12C07/V16C02 primary source records; no fresh body/image inspection or unverified institutional claim.
full_reading.scope_limits: No empirical discovery, authorized intervention, novelty certificate, human grading outcome, general welfare inference or final-paper equivalence claimed.

result.qualitative_review: Full design contracts, reasoning and solutions read and recorded; not inferred from keywords.

canonical_promotion: Root path-only promotion from preserved working freeze; actual canonical gates recorded separately.
